林川没有避开客厅里的人。

电话接通后，他只交代了一句。

“让苏晚棠先接待，不争辩，所有流程留痕。”

挂断电话，他扶住李秀兰。

“妈，先进去，外面风大。”

李秀兰停在门口。

“是不是出事了？”

“没有，有人举报。”

林川语气很平。

李秀兰脸色变了。

林建国也放下茶杯。

“公司那边？”

“不是公司。”

林川扶着李秀兰在沙发坐下，又给林建国倒了杯茶。

“衡复片区我刚开了家茶楼，有人举报。”

这些词一出来，李秀兰坐不住了。

“小川，上海规矩多，咱别跟人硬顶。现在日子好了，别惹麻烦。”

林建国没开口。

他以前当厂长，最怕这种事。

手续、章、检查、举报。

一张纸压下来，厂里半个月都别想安生。

林川把茶推到父亲手边。

“爸，以前别人欺负我们，是因为我们没背景，也没筹码。”

林建国抬起头。

林川继续开口。

“现在不一样。”

“现在没人能随便欺负我们。”

客厅安静下来。

李秀兰看着儿子，半天才低声念了一句。

“那你也别累着。”

“嗯。”

王桂芬坐在旁边，心里松了一口气。

刚才别墅、沈荣庭、九州这些东西压得她喘不过气，现在一听林川被举报，她那点不平衡总算冒了头。

“林川啊，上海不比江城。”

她斟酌着开口。

“这里办事，还是稳一点好。真被本地人盯上，手续卡起来，很麻烦。”

林海也跟了一句。

“对，尤其老房子改商业，水深。消防、街道哪一项都不好过。”

这话不算难听。

但客厅里的人都听得出味道。

林海终于找到了能开口的地方。

张虎坐在旁边剥橘子。

他把橘子皮丢进垃圾桶，抬头笑了下。

“堂哥，手续复杂，是给不懂规矩的人看的。”

林海脸色一僵。

张虎掰下一瓣橘子。

“我们九州，不属于这个行列。”

林海忍着气。

“我不是说你们公司不行，我只是提醒。”

“提醒挺好。”

张虎点头。

“不过我们一般不靠嘴说，靠材料。”

王桂芬胸口又堵上了。

这小张吃饭时看着老实，开口一句比一句扎人。

林川没有接这茬。

“爸，妈，先休息。”

他转向林小冉。

“小冉，带他们去看房间。”

林小冉立刻起身。

“保证完成任务。”

林川上楼进了书房。

门一关，客厅里的声音被隔在外面。

十分钟后，叶知秋把材料传了过来。

投诉内容列得很完整。

叶知秋的电话随后打进来。

“林总，实名举报人是陆骁，但材料不像他写的。”

林川翻到最后一页签名处。

“许泰。”

“我也这么判断。尤其历史风貌那部分，用词很专业，普通人不会这么写。”

“查许泰。”

“最近三天，他见过谁，尤其是街道、消防顾问、历史建筑咨询公司这几条线。”

“收到。”

顾城的电话紧跟着进来，火气压不住。

“我去找陆启明。”

“不用。”

Lin Chuan did not avoid the people in the living room.

After the call was connected, he only confessed one sentence.

"Let Su Wantang receive you first, don't argue, and leave traces of the entire process."

After hanging up the phone, he supported Li Xiulan.

"Mom, go in first, it's windy outside."

Li Xiulan stopped at the door.

"Did something happen?"

"No, someone reported it."

Lin Chuan's tone was calm.

Li Xiulan's expression changed.

Lin Jianguo also put down his teacup.

"Where is the company?"

"Not a company."

Lin Chuan helped Li Xiulan sit down on the sofa and poured Lin Jianguo another cup of tea.

"I just opened a teahouse in Hengfu Film District, and someone reported it."

As soon as these words came out, Li Xiulan couldn't sit still.

"Xiaochuan, there are a lot of rules in Shanghai, so don't try to match others. Life is getting better now, so don't cause trouble."

Lin Jianguo didn't speak.

He used to be a factory manager and was most afraid of this kind of thing.

Procedures, stamps, inspections, reports.

If a piece of paper is pressed down, the factory will not be able to live in peace for half a month.

Lin Chuan pushed the tea to his father's hand.

"Dad, people bullied us before because we had no background and no leverage."

Lin Jianguo raised his head.

Lin Chuan continued to speak.

"It's different now."

"No one can bully us now."

The living room fell silent.

Li Xiulan looked at her son and whispered something for a long time.

"Then don't be tired."

"Yeah."

Wang Guifen sat next to him and breathed a sigh of relief.

The villa, Shen Rongting, and Jiuzhou had overwhelmed her just now, but now that Lin Chuan had been reported, her imbalance finally came to the fore.

"Linchuan, Shanghai is not as good as Jiangcheng."

She spoke carefully.

"It's better to be more stable when doing things here. I'm really being targeted by the locals and the procedures are stuck. It's very troublesome."

Lin Hai also followed suit.

"Yes, especially when old houses are converted into commercial buildings, the water is deep. Fire protection and streets are not easy to survive."

This is not an unpleasant thing to say.

But everyone in the living room could smell it.

Lin Hai finally found a place to speak.

Zhang Hu was sitting next to him peeling oranges.

He threw the orange peel into the trash can, looked up and smiled.

"Cousin, the procedures are complicated and are for people who don't understand the rules."

Lin Hai's face froze.

Zhang Hu broke off a piece of orange.

"We in Kyushu do not belong to this category."

Lin Hai held back his anger.

"I'm not saying your company isn't good, I'm just reminding you."

"It's a good reminder."

Zhang Hu nodded.

"But we usually don't rely on words, we rely on materials."

Wang Guifen's chest was blocked again.

This little Zhang looked honest when he was eating, and every word he spoke was more irritating.

Lin Chuan didn't take the initiative.

"Dad, Mom, rest first."

He turned to Lin Xiaoran.

"Xiaoran, show them the room."

Lin Xiaoran stood up immediately.

"Make sure to complete the mission."

Lin Chuan went upstairs and entered the study.

As soon as the door was closed, the sounds in the living room were blocked out.

Ten minutes later, Ye Zhiqiu passed the materials over.

The complaint is listed in full.

Ye Zhiqiu's call came later.

"Mr. Lin, the real-name reporter is Lu Xiao, but the material does not look like he wrote it."

Lin Chuan turned to the signature on the last page.

"Xu Tai."

"I think so too. Especially for the historical part, the wording is very professional and ordinary people would not write it like this."

"Chaxutai."

"Who has he seen in the past three days, especially the streets, fire consultants, and historical building consulting companies."

"Roger that."

Gu Cheng's call came right after him, and he couldn't hold back his anger.

"I'm going to find Lu Qiming."

"No need."
